messages:
olivia: Async check-in — traffic shift for inference-v2. What I did: kicked off a 10% traffic shift at 02:30 UTC. Observed p95 latency ~1.2x baseline, error-rate unchanged. Blockers: need embed endpoint canary metrics surfaced in console, and the traffic-shaper script sometimes double-applies when retrying.

deploy-bot: ingress-shift job started for inference-v2 -> 10% at 02:30:05 UTC (job id 78321)

jon: saw the same p95 bump, looks like increased tail due to longer KV-cache misses. digging into cache-hit ratios.

chris: SRE queue — I added a temporary alert for p95 > 1.5x baseline and error-rate > 0.5% during rollout. Canary cutoff rule set at 30% within 15m window. Will cut if triggered. :thumbsup:

maya: excellent. FYI product: holding staged experiments until we confirm embedding quality is stable — please surface any regressed prompts.

olivia: blocker for me — where are the embed canary metrics? can't find the per-model embedding score in the console for the canary group.

jon: ah, metrics pipeline didn't tag the canary label on embed-worker v2. Quick fix pushed, will backfill ~10m of data. Patch:

```bash
# add canary tag to pipeline config
sed -i 's/model_id/model_id,cohort/' metrics/ingest/config.yaml
kubectl rollout restart ds/metrics-ingest
```

deploy-bot: rollout patch applied to metrics-ingest at 03:10 UTC. Backfill job queued (id 78377).

chris: infra note — traffic-shaper idempotency issue reproduced. Patch in PR #1428, adds a lock file to prevent double-apply. Requesting review @jon.

jon: reviewing now. Also I'll add an extra check to ignore duplicate jobs by comparing job-id and timestamp.

olivia: plan for today: pause further traffic increases until backfill finishes and p95 stabilizes. If no regressions in 45m, escalate to 25% with SRE monitoring. CC @maya

maya: sounds good. I'm prepping a small eval set to run against canary responses — will post results here.

infra-bot: backfill job 78377 started (ETA ~8m). Monitoring metrics ingestion.

olivia: thanks everyone — ping here with any blocking errors or if cutoff fires. No urgent customer impact reported.

chris: noted, will update if cutoff triggers.

jon: quick heads-up — a couple of CRs incoming for the traffic-shaper lock and metrics tag. Expecting to merge in the next 30m.

maya: thanks — will hold the feature docs until we have stable metrics. :white_check_mark:
